map.图案位置记忆游戏 使用指南: Pattern Position Memory Game User Guide
map.在 N×N 网格短暂高亮若干格，消失后要求点击还原这些位置；亮格数随关卡增加，错: In an N x N grid, several cells light up briefly; after they disappear you must click to restore those positions, and the lit cell count grows with each level; one mistake ends the level and is recorded. ...
map.视觉记忆：闪现网格中若干亮格，要求复原其位置。: Visual memory: several lit cells flash in a grid and you must restore their positions.
map.难度递增：亮格数量随关卡增多。: Difficulty increases: the number of lit cells grows with the level.
map.脑力训练：记录达成关卡。: Brain training: records the levels reached.
map.和 shape/emoji memory 区别？: How is it different from the shape/emoji memory game?
map.规则同属位置记忆；本工具用抽象网格图案，emoji/shape 用具体图标，练的: The rule is the same as position memory; this tool uses abstract grid patterns while emoji/shape use concrete icons, but both train spatial position memory.
map.怎么记更多格？: How can I remember more cells?
map.给每格编行列坐标、分组记忆，比逐格硬记容量更大。: Assigning each cell row-column coordinates and grouping them for memory gives far more capacity than memorizing cell by cell.
